spiritual_reading.full_translation:
Know this, my beloved ones: when Divine influx entered into operation, it brought with it a full complement of outer forms for action in the lowest degree—one form suited to the spread and shaping of perception, one form suited to the ignition and ordering of affection, and one form suited to the communication and ordering of truth. It took these outer forms from what could be received at that level, and acted through them in the threefold order, so that every thing in the whole domain—within higher states and within lower states—might be held together under one government. It disposed these outer forms in the outmost plane where manifestation occurs, and there it made itself evident. Afterwards, when the works were completed in that plane, it removed those outer forms in the presence of those who were in good, so that what was merely instrumental might not be regarded as the Divine itself.

Then, when it was about to release what had been bound in those outer forms, it loosened their conjunction and put them off from their fixed attachment, and so those three outer forms were left disposed in their proper order within the ultimate boundary of that plane, encompassing it completely from the lowest limit up through the middle degree and onward toward higher reach. Yet from the inmost and highest point, a superior action withdrew that outermost encompassing from the place where it had served, and it was set beneath the remaining order and at the same time elevated into higher states, returning to the heights from which it had first proceeded when the process began.

paragraph_translations.translation: Know this, my beloved ones: when Divine influx entered into operation, it brought with it a threefold investing for outward work—one investing suited to the spread and shaping of perception, one suited to the ignition and ordering of love, and one suited to the communication and ordering of truth. It took these investings from what could first be formed and received in the lowest degree, and it exerted its power within them according to that threefold order, establishing by them the stability of all things in the whole domain, within higher states and within lower states. It disposed these investings in the ultimate boundary where manifestation is made evident. Afterwards, when the works in that ultimate plane had been completed, it removed those investings in the presence of those who were in good.
paragraph_translations.connection: DEVELOPS: it sets out the threefold outward investing of Divine operation and its later removal after use is finished.
paragraph_translations.notes: The opening clause about “first formation” is textually uncertain; rendered as the first receivable formation in the lowest degree. “Before the righteous ones” reads cleanly as presence of those in good.

paragraph_translations.translation: Then, when it was about to release what had been held together by those outward investings, it loosened their fixed conjunction and put them off from their fastening, and left them disposed in their proper order within the ultimate boundary of that plane, so that they encompassed it completely from the lowest limit up toward the middle degree and onward toward higher reach. Yet from the inmost and highest point, a superior action drew away that ultimate encompassing from the place where it had served, and it was set beneath the remaining order and also lifted into higher states, returning to the heights from which it had first proceeded when the process began.
paragraph_translations.connection: CONTINUES: it describes the loosening of the outer forms and their re-ordering and elevation back toward higher states.
paragraph_translations.notes: The description of the ‘zone’ and ‘edges’ is fragmentary; translated as the ultimate boundary/plane of manifestation and its limits. The clause about ‘above them strips them’ is syntactically broken; rendered as an inmost action withdrawing the outermost encompassing.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a single teaching about Divine operation through a threefold outward investing in the ultimate degree, followed by the removal and reordering of those instrumentals once their use is completed. The second paragraph has clear textual damage around the boundary/zone mechanics, but the spiritual motion—loosening conjunction, leaving ordered externals, then withdrawal and elevation toward higher states—remains consistent with the chapter’s voice.

findings.diagnosis: Coherent correspondential substrate: the three ‘garments’ are taught by what they DO in the cosmological/process narrative (investing, operating, establishing, then being stripped off after completion). The spiritual reading does not stumble here except for minor bracketed damage; there is no sign of later administrative jurisdictional overlay.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by function and process: “he brought the three garments; that of wind, that of fire, and that of water… his power was operating in them… he established [them] for all the things of [this universe], both above and below… Afterwards… [he] stripped them off before [the righteous] ones.” The Stage 3a reading tracks this smoothly (“threefold outward investing… acted through them… removed those investings…”) and only notes uncertainty at “first formation,” which is bracketed/damaged rather than a voice-shift.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine difficulty from textual damage and syntactic breakage in a still-correspondential passage. The narrative remains the same functional/process teaching (divesting, leaving arranged, clothing the zone, withdrawal/elevation), but the mechanics of the ‘zone/edges/middle/topmost point’ have been corrupted, creating the precise point where the spiritual reading had to supply a smoothing paraphrase (“a superior action withdrew…”). This is not an insertion: there is no administrative list, no jurisdictions, no named governors; the stumbling is best explained by lacunae and disordered clauses.
findings.evidence: The paragraph is densely bracketed and internally broken: “he was about to loose [oose them from them, he]… divested himself… [left them arranged]… arranged [in their order] from below the edges of the zone… from below up [to the middle]… [and from the middle] up [to above]… above them strips them of the zone…” The Stage 3a notes explicitly: “The description of the ‘zone’ and ‘edges’ is fragmentary… The clause about ‘above them strips them’ is syntactically broken.” The reader’s solution (“rendered as an inmost action withdrawing…”) is a compensatory reconstruction, not evidence of a foreign teaching layer.

textual_criticism.summary: 2 findings. No administrative-voice intrusions detected. One clean correspondential section (¶1) and one correspondential passage with substantial textual damage (¶2). Recommended excisions: 0. Recommended annotations as overlay blocks: 0. All difficulties are best explained by lacunae/scribal disruption rather than insertion.
